content.note: Product reviewed the support tickets after planning had started and widened the scope to custom aliases.
content.text: Several users have told support that our short links "feel too easy to guess". Fix it. UPDATE from product after reviewing the tickets: half of the complaints are about custom aliases like 'sale1' and 'promo2', not generated codes. Also enforce a minimum length of 6 characters for custom aliases. Existing short aliases must keep working.
